items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I don’t know if you’ve ever heard her but she was a preeminent band director who taught all of the musicians in New Orleans from everybody who played with Fats Domino to you know Ellis Marsalis, Harold Batiste, I mean Yvonne Bush.

ctx.x: Yeah where’s the craftsmanship? You know. Where is the musicianship? You know what are they learning. You see I’m telling you man a long time ago with these band directors, you have to play in tune, you have to play correctly, you have to have good posture, good musicianship. I mean man it was just like I’m sure if you haven’t, just ask any New Orleanean about Yvonne Bush. I don’t know if you’ve ever heard her but she was a preeminent band director who taught all of the musicians in New Orleans from everybody who…
Well I hope you play an important role in all that. And I have a feeling you will somehow or other.
